facts.text: Pass the apple pie, please. I have to split an atom before supper, so no seconds.
facts.why: Not in the film. A real line from the opened quote page that fits the Marie Curie wink is 'Just a moment Marie, I'm having an idea.'
facts.fix: Just a moment Marie, I'm having an idea.

fix_note.text: Just a moment Marie, I'm having an idea.

facts.text: Eaten in the shed beside the electric guitar.
facts.why: The shed is where Einstein splits the beer atom. He invents the electric violin in Sydney and later turns it into an electric guitar after the institution.
facts.fix: Eaten in the shed where he split the beer atom.

facts.text: Electric guitar invented in the shed
facts.why: Same as above. The guitar is rebuilt from his violin after he is committed, not made in the shed.
facts.fix: Electric guitar built from his smashed violin

vibe.verdict: The apple farm kiosk and beer bubbles are right, but two lines get the guitar wrong and the best Sydney and Nobel moments are missing.
